syllabusObjectives: Understand foundational principles of IC Design.
Apply analytical engineering methods to solve problems in IC Design.
Conduct design, laboratory or computational exercises relevant to IC Design.

courses.title: Microwave Communications
courses.description: Waveguide modes, microstrip lines, S-parameters, Smith chart matching networks, microwave amplifiers, and horn antennas.
syllabusObjectives: Understand foundational principles of Microwave Communications.
Apply analytical engineering methods to solve problems in Microwave Communications.
Conduct design, laboratory or computational exercises relevant to Microwave Communications.

courses.title: Power System Protection
courses.description: Overcurrent, directional, differential, and distance protective relays; instrument transformers; and digital substation automation (IEC 61850).
syllabusObjectives: Understand foundational principles of Power System Protection.
Apply analytical engineering methods to solve problems in Power System Protection.
Conduct design, laboratory or computational exercises relevant to Power System Protection.
